title: Breaking the Long Horizon: Short-Horizon Process Supervision for Long-Form Generation in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.27348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-form generation is increasingly important for agentic LLM systems, yet current reinforcement learning methods typically optimize an entire document with a single outcome-level reward. This delayed and coarse-grained supervision makes it difficult to localize errors and assign credit across semantically distinct parts of the output. To address this, we propose a short-horizon framework that reformulates long-form generation through semantic decomposition into segment-level decisions. Each segment is generated with prefix-conditioned context, allowing cross-segment coherence to be preserved while keeping supervision local. The generated segments are then scored with rubric-based rewards for adherence, coherence, and relevance, enabling explicit local supervision at the segment level. translated_title: 突破长时程：面向大语言模型长文本生成的短时程过程监督
translated_abstract: 长文本生成对智能体化的大语言模型系统日益重要，然而当前的强化学习方法通常使用单一的结果级奖励来优化整个文档。这种延迟且粗粒度的监督使得难以定位错误，并难以在输出中语义不同的部分之间进行信用分配。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种短时程框架，通过将长文本生成语义分解为片段级决策来重新构建该任务。每个片段都在前缀条件化的上下文中生成，从而在保持监督局部化的同时保留跨片段的连贯性。生成的片段随后依据依从性、连贯性和相关性使用基于评分标准的奖励进行评分，从而在片段级别实现显式的局部监督。这些局部奖励被用于计算逐步优势，进而产生局部化的策略更新。为隔离监督粒度的影响，我们设计……
tldr: 该论文提出一种短时程过程监督框架，将长文本生成分解为片段级决策，并利用基于评分标准的局部奖励计算逐步优势、实现局部化策略更新，从而解决传统结果级奖励监督延迟且粗粒度、难以定位错误和分配信用的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a short-horizon process supervision framework that decomposes long-form generation into segment-level decisions with rubric-based local rewards, enabling step-wise advantage computation and localized policy updates to overcome the delayed, coarse-grained nature of outcome-level rewards.
